::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/brand_images/capability"}
#docs
Check this before offering an upload control: when `upload_enabled` is false, set the brand image fields to an externally hosted https URL instead.

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type. |
| `upload_enabled` | `boolean` | false when this deployment has no object storage configured |
| `accepts` | `object` | The content types each asset accepts. `logo` and `signature` are narrower than the rest because they are embedded in the invoice PDF, which cannot carry GIF or WebP. Read this rather than hard-coding a file filter. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Success |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/brand_images/capability" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY"
```

#response
```json [200 OK]
{
  "object": "brand_image_capability",
  "upload_enabled": false,
  "accepts": {
    "logo": [
      "Logo"
    ],
    "icon": [
      "Icon"
    ],
    "favicon": [
      "Favicon"
    ],
    "signature": [
      "Signature"
    ],
    "product": [
      "pro"
    ]
  }
}
```
::
